c203_preselected.metric_primary: RQA ratio RTE/DET on delay-embedded log-volume returns. RTE=Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution (qualifying gaps w>=w_min=1, excluding trivial self i==j; p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u, RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive). DET=RQA determinism = (sum of recurrent points belonging to diagonal lines of length >= l_min) / (sum of all off-diagonal recurrent points) in the trailing window (standard RQA, fail-closed if denominator <=0 or DET non-finite/out of [0,1] bounds as applicable). RATIO_RTE_DET=RTE/DET. Params m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,l_min=2,w_min=1. Fail-closed NaN/no-signal if RTE undefined/non-finite/degenerate, DET undefined/non-finite/degenerate (including zero/near-zero denominator), ratio non-finite, or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps. Trailing/causal only.
